args.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Please treat the gassy smell as serious, even if it's only occasional. If you smell gas now: leave the flat, leave the door open behind you, don't use light switches, naked flames or your oven/hob, and call the National Gas Emergency line free on 0800 111 999 from outside. If you're in immediate danger call 999. Please don't use the oven until it has been checked. We're arranging an urgent safety check by a gas engineer, and I'll also get the oven problem looked at. We'll be in touch about access. Thanks, Northbridge Lettings
